title: Smart Data Models - TM Forum Open APIs - SalesOpportunity
description: A Sales Opportunity represents a qualified potential for a sale, created when a prospect demonstrates a concrete and actionable interest. As a formal entry in the sales pipeline, it is tracked with an estimated value, a timeline, and a probability of success. Its lifecycle is managed through defined sales stages until it is won or lost. (TM Forum TMF699 Sales Management 5.0.0, OpenAPI component SalesOpportunity; attribute names kept verbatim except the NGSI-LD reserved terms / JSON-LD keywords renamed with a tmf prefix (id, @type, @baseType, @schemaLocation, ...); deprecated attributes left out.)

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity: urn:ngsi-ld:SalesOpportunity:<tmfId>.

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'SalesOpportunity'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

Renamed from TMF '@type' (JSON-LD keyword). TMF class name of the instance: 'SalesOpportunity' or a sub-class / extension name. When sub-classing, this defines the sub-class Extensible name

tmfBaseType.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF699_Sales/blob/v5.0.0/TMF699-Sales-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Extensible/properties/@baseType'. Renamed from TMF '@baseType' (JSON-LD keyword). When sub-classing, this defines the super-class

creationDate.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF699_Sales/blob/v5.0.0/TMF699-Sales-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/SalesOpportunity/properties/creationDate'. Date and time of the SalesOpportunity creation

description.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF699_Sales/blob/v5.0.0/TMF699-Sales-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/SalesOpportunity/properties/description'. Concise and comprehensive description of the SalesOpportunity

salesLead.description: Relationship. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF699_Sales/blob/v5.0.0/TMF699-Sales-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/SalesOpportunity/properties/salesLead'. References to the SalesLead resources that gave rise to this SalesOpportunity. In TMF this is an array of SalesLeadRef objects; here the NGSI-LD ids of the referenced SalesLead entities (urn:ngsi-ld:SalesLead:<tmf id>). Inline values and reference metadata (href, name, @referredType) are not kept.

rating.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF699_Sales/blob/v5.0.0/TMF699-Sales-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/SalesOpportunity/properties/rating'. Identifies the potential of the opportunity for becoming a sale, with common values being hot, warm, or cold. This overall rating is typically aggregated from its items, often reflecting the highest potential among them.

referredDate.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF699_Sales/blob/v5.0.0/TMF699-Sales-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/SalesOpportunity/properties/referredDate'. Date when the prospect information was received (for example, from a trade show).

statusChangeDate.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF699_Sales/blob/v5.0.0/TMF699-Sales-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/SalesOpportunity/properties/statusChangeDate'. Date and time of the last update of status.

statusChangeReason.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF699_Sales/blob/v5.0.0/TMF699-Sales-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/SalesOpportunity/properties/statusChangeReason'. Reason why the status has changed

revenueEstimate.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF699_Sales/blob/v5.0.0/TMF699-Sales-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/SalesOpportunity/properties/revenueEstimate'. The channel to which the resource reference to. e.g. channel for selling product offerings, channel for opening a trouble ticket etc..

marketSegment.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF699_Sales/blob/v5.0.0/TMF699-Sales-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/SalesOpportunity/properties/marketSegment'. provides references to the corresponding market segment as target of product offerings. note.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF699_Sales/blob/v5.0.0/TMF699-Sales-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/SalesOpportunity/properties/note'. A user-generated text entry providing contextual information or commentary.

agreement.description: Relationship. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF699_Sales/blob/v5.0.0/TMF699-Sales-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/SalesOpportunity/properties/agreement'. A formal agreement that documents the commercial terms and commitments negotiated and agreed upon during the lifecycle of a sales opportunity. In TMF this is an array of AgreementRef objects; here the NGSI-LD ids of the referenced Agreement entities (urn:ngsi-ld:Agreement:<tmf id>). Inline values and reference metadata (href, name, @referredType) are not kept.

relatedParty.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF699_Sales/blob/v5.0.0/TMF699-Sales-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/SalesOpportunity/properties/relatedParty'. A formal offer, generated during the sales opportunity lifecycle, that details the proposed products, services, and pricing. In TMF this is an array of QuoteRef objects; here the NGSI-LD ids of the referenced Quote entities (urn:ngsi-ld:Quote:<tmf id>). Inline values and reference metadata (href, name, @referredType) are not kept.
